02 / Wordmark

A name with presence.

The proposed wordmark uses custom geometric lowercase letters, a forward lean and a diamond over the “i”. It is constructed with HTML and CSS, without SVG or image assets.

IAMTAW / SIGNATURE WORDMARKUNMISTAKABLY ME.
Serious skill.
Big personality.✳
THE EVERYDAY SIGNATURE
THE LOUDER SIDE

Usage

  • Write the brand name iamtaw as one lowercase word.
  • Primary: pink wordmark with lime dot on mulberry.
  • Everyday: all mulberry on cream.
  • Single colour: all cream on plum ink.
  • Social avatar: the custom “i” with diamond dot on mulberry.

Space and scale

  • Leave clear space equal to the height of the “i” diamond on every side.
  • Provisional minimum full-wordmark width: 140px digital or 30mm print; verify on the final output.
  • Use the avatar treatment below that size.
  • Do not stretch, outline, add shadows or place the mark over busy photographs.
  • Keep taglines separate from the wordmark.

This is a working logo proposal, not an approved final mark. Print and static image exports should follow once the letterforms are approved. Do not add a registered trademark symbol.

03 / Colour

Depth. Expression. Surprise.

MulberrySignature#641C34
Electric pinkPersonality#FF79AD
Sharp limeSmall surprises#D7F45B
Warm creamBreathing room#FFF6E8
Plum inkText & depth#211B29

Default page balance: 60% cream, 25% mulberry, 10% pink, 5% lime. Plum ink handles body text. These are composition guides, not quotas; a social post can be mostly pink.

PairUseContrast

Avoid cream body text on pink and lime text on cream. Keep lime as a small accent on ordinary pages. RGB/HEX values are for screens; proof any print conversion with the printer.

04 / Typography

Clear enough to sell.
Distinct enough to remember.

Headlines / Manrope ExtraBold

Make your
next move.

Weight 800. Tight spacing, short lines, sentence case. Suggested desktop heading: 64px; mobile: 40px.

Body / DM Sans

Good design should help people understand your business, find what they need and take the next step.

Weight 400–500. Body 16–18px, line height 1.6. Labels 12px and above.

A little audacity.

Georgia Italic: one expressive phrase per composition. Keep forms and service details in DM Sans.

Fallbacks: Manrope → Arial; DM Sans → Arial; Georgia → serif. The logo uses its own CSS letterforms and does not depend on these fonts.

05 / Voice

Sound like a person
who knows her work.

How we speak

  • Lead with what the client needs.
  • Use short, direct sentences and specific details.
  • Let the humour sit beside the message.
  • Use natural Nigerian English when the conversation suits it.
  • Keep pricing, scope and payment messages precise.

What to leave out

  • “Unlock”, “revolutionise” and vague transformation claims.
  • Forced slang in every sentence.
  • Invented testimonials, metrics or promises of guaranteed sales.
  • Apologetic pricing or pressure to buy.
  • Jokes that make clients feel foolish about their current website.

06 / Visual language

One bold move at a time.

Layout & shapes

Use generous cream space, strong alignment and one oversized headline. Rounded buttons create warmth; a diamond dot, a tilted label or an asterisk adds a small surprise. Use one of these accents per layout.

Use an 8px spacing base: 8, 16, 24, 32, 48, 64. Buttons: at least 44px high. Corners: 16px for content panels and full rounding for action buttons.

Images & movement

Prioritise real project screenshots, process details and natural photographs. Show mobile work as clearly as desktop work. Keep images bright enough to inspect.

Use quick 180–240ms transitions, small movement and clear feedback. Respect reduced-motion preferences. Keep the wordmark still in documents and invoices.
